name: Keys
description: A typing speed test: type the words as fast and as accurately as you can.
hint: Type to start · Tab + Enter restart
whatsNew: Zephydian is now Zephdeck: updated for the new name.

howTo.goal: Type the words as fast and as accurately as you can.
rules: The timer starts with your first key.
Mistakes turn red; Space moves on to the next word.
WPM counts only correctly typed words; accuracy counts every key.
The menu picks a time or word count, punctuation, numbers, code, and keyboard sound.
